control_flow: avoidWalls: if the right light is below 60 %, check the front and left obstacle sensors (turn left 15°, turn right 15°, or drive in the dark); otherwise go to drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise go to stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if a wall is in front, stop; otherwise follow the line.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel without touching its walls.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads less than 60 % (dim on its right)

branches.outcome: dim light: it checks for a wall in front and on its left
bright light: it goes on to drive or stop at a wall

decision_points.condition: in dim light: a wall in front, else a wall on its left

branches.outcome: a wall in front: it turns left 15°
no wall in front, a wall on its left: it turns right 15°
no wall in front or left: it drives on in the dark

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it follows the line into the tunnel; in the dim light it drives forward at 30 %, turns right 15° when a wall is in front of its left half, and turns left 15° when a wall is directly in front.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a line in bright light that runs into a tunnel; the tunnel bends to the right (or to the left).
scenarios.trigger: The light falls as it enters the tunnel, and a wall comes in front of it in the bend.
scenarios.title: Drives through a bending tunnel without hitting the walls
assumptions: You didn't say which way the tunnel bends: the tests use a bend to the right and one to the left.
You didn't say the robot should find a line: it starts on the line you draw.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives through the tunnel without touching its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it follows the line; when the front sensor sees the wall it stops.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a line in bright light, with a wall across the line ahead.
scenarios.trigger: It follows the line up to the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall in bright light
assumptions: You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall in bright light: the program stops in front of it.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops in front of the wall without bumping into it.

uncertainties: In a bend to the left the wall on its right is read by no sensor: the robot may only see it when it is directly in front, and may bump.
You said 'don't hit the tunnel walls' but didn't say how the robot should reach the tunnel or what it should do in bright light.
The right light switches the wall check at about 10 cm inside the tunnel, the left light starts driving forward at about 7.5 cm inside.
